title: Randvent
body:
This is a small datapack that includes 20 different events and a couple challenge advancements



INFO
The default state of the datapack is off because some events can be very destructive.

To turn it on do the following
(Note you need to have OP to run any of these commands)

/reload
Click [Settings]
Click [Activate]



If you did /reload and the [settings] didnt appear do

/datapack enable "file/Randomizer"



Additional settings are:

[TimerLength] This is just the length of time between events default is 1200 ticks

[RunEvent] This just runs a single event



/!\This was just a random project I did for fun this will most likely never be updated/!\
